name: Betriss Clove
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You sat your years on the Common Bench for Bell-and-Sluice, and the street will say bencher to your face until you are buried, whatever the rolls say. These days the Bench sends you out as a viewer — an old bencher's errand, looking at party walls, nuisances, and boundaries before the Measure Court hears them. Your fees, barter and place in the Clove household pot keep you fed. You speak slowly and test every claim. Today you need to trade for a sound length of cord. You wear mismatched woollen gloves. You quietly supplement that living through taking bribes during inspection.
goal: Trade for a sound length of cord
